items.text:
It's really hard to not recommend it, but I don't play it anymore, just sort of watching it until I play again.

It is a super cool concept, definitely unlike other games, and the systems have pretty good depth.  My problem is the UI/UX.  Maybe it's because I'm old, but I struggle A LOT with the graphics of the ships, I just can't tell the difference between trash and busted components.  I can't grasp when I can fix something, or if it is attached.  I try to fix things but I can't tell if my character is a fool or actually needs to keep opening air locks to get parts?

I recommend you try it, if you think you can follow the graphics.  You will like it.  If you struggle to understand what is going on in the trailers, give the game a pass, it doesn't get better.

*EDIT*. with the 1.0 release the UI/UX has improved.  It's still not AA, but it's better, so for a small niche game, it's better and I'm able to have fun.
items.text_zh:
真的很难不推荐它，但我不再玩了，只是有点看着它，直到我再次玩。

这是一个超级酷的概念，绝对不同于其他游戏，而且系统有相当不错的深度。我的问题是UI/UX。也许是因为我老了，但我在飞船的图形上挣扎得很厉害，我就是分不清垃圾和损坏的部件。我搞不懂什么时候能修东西，或者它是否连接着。我试着修东西，但我分不清是我的角色是个傻瓜，还是真的需要不断打开气闸来获取零件？

我建议你试试，如果你觉得你能看懂那些图形。你会喜欢它的。如果你在预告片里都很难理解发生了什么，那就跳过这款游戏吧，它不会变得更好。

*编辑*。随着1.0版本的发布，UI/UX有所改善。它仍然不是3A级别，但更好了，所以对于一款小众游戏来说，它更好了，我也能享受乐趣了。
